title: Different ideas.
Different experiences.
Different results.
about.lead: Different is a creative marketing agency that works hand in hand with travel and tourism brands. We start where every trip starts, with a feeling, then build the ideas, content and campaigns that turn that feeling into a plan.
about.body: A destination is never just a place. It's the light at golden hour, the story a guide tells, the moment someone decides this is where they want to be. Our job is to find that moment and put it in front of the right people.

principles.title: Start with the feeling
principles.body: Before formats and deadlines, we ask what the traveller should feel. Everything else follows from that.

principles.title: Say it differently
principles.body: Travel feeds tend to look alike. We look for the angle, the tone and the detail only your brand can own.

principles.title: Made to move people
principles.body: Looking good is the starting point. The idea has to move people from scrolling to planning.
